author: DaFrozenBlaze
body:
I know this had been brought up before but I can't find the thread, so I'll bring it up again
Combat logging should not be allowed on scrim servers
It's misleading when people combat log.
For example, if someone is knocked off and he doesn't die, you don't know if he lived or combat logged.
I saw it today when LFT got confused during a match
So yea

replies.author: hasl
replies.body: When a competitive match is played it has the potential to be misleading, but what if you're just mucking around and don't want the other person to kill you? At present, I don't think this should be removed, however, if crates and credits are disabled on scrim servers then perhaps, but still, that wouldn't change the fact that if you want to troll your friends,  combat logging should be allowed.

replies.author: Iron
replies.body: I agree with you actually. Whether playing with a friend or not, you should not be able to just leave and (in its current state) deny a user their credits.
